title: Adhyaya 2: Classical Duties & Dharma
summary: Canonical verses on traditional righteousness from Adhyaya 2.
ai_summary: Exposition of ethical conduct and cosmic law according to Sage Manu in Adhyaya 2.

verses.original: वेदोऽखिलो धर्ममूलं स्मृतिशीले च तद्विदाम् । आचारश्चैव साधूनामात्मनस्तुष्टिरेव च ॥
verses.transliteration: vedo'khilo dharmamūlaṁ smṛtiśīle ca tadvidām | ācāraścaiva sādhūnāmātmanastuṣṭireva ca ||
verses.translation: The entire Veda is the foundational root of Dharma; next, the Smritis and the virtuous character of those who know the Veda; then the conduct of the virtuous; and finally the inner satisfaction of one's own conscience.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: Manu defines the four authoritative sources of ethical and legal conduct (Dharma Pramana).

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: The entire Veda is the foundational root of Dharma; next, the Smritis and the virtuous character of those who know the Veda; then the conduct of the virtuous; and finally the inner satisfaction of one's own conscience.

layers.author: buhler
layers.author_label: Sacred Books of the East Vol 25
layers.content: मनुस्मृती अध्याय 2: Manu defines the four authoritative sources of ethical and legal conduct (Dharma Pramana).

verses.original: यद्यद्ध्याचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरो जनः । स यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते ॥
verses.transliteration: yadyaddhyācarati śreṣṭhastattadevetaro janaḥ | sa yatpramāṇaṁ kurute lokastadanuvartate ||
verses.translation: Whatever action an exalted person performs, that very action other people emulate; whatever standard he sets, the world follows.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: Moral leadership by exemplary conduct sets the gold standard for society.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: Whatever action an exalted person performs, that very action other people emulate; whatever standard he sets, the world follows.

layers.author: buhler
